snippet.title: Frame of Mind: A Game of Thoughts - Accessibility Trailer - Access-Ability Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts is a brief and cozy narrative game that lets you explore a character through thoughts and momentos you find in stages of their life. Its an introspective game, meant to share some experiences a peer-group of neurodivergent queers, including the developer, had growing up.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2515480/Frame_of_Mind__A_game_of_thoughts/

---------------------------

As a disabled-led team, Many Cats Studios partners with the games industry to create more accessible games, ensuring players of all abilities can participate in their love of gaming. The studio operates with authenticity and a commitment to a healthy, sustainable remote work culture.

Visit Many Cats Studios to learn more or discuss accessibility support for your game.
https://www.manycats.uk/

------------------------------

TechRaptor.net is a games media website, founded back in 2013, that publishes high-quality news, reviews, opinions, features, and guides for both video games and tabletop games.

As someone who has been a staff writer, freelancer, and editor at a number of major games media websites over the last decade, I can vouch for the quality of writing and reporting over on TechRaptor. 

They have a firm anti-AI stance and put a portion of their profits each year towards supporting great causes.

You can find their coverage at https://techraptor.net./

--------------------------

Riott Roquette are a queer art punk collective that blends elements of psycho pop and circus dance in their live performances.

Their debut album, Idiot SavantGarde, is out now: https://riottrockette.bandcamp.com/album/idiot-savantgarde-2
